learning_outcomes.text: Students explain their knowledge about natural and healthy nutrition and become aware of combating obesity.
Students know the concepts related to growth and development and have the necessary information for a healthy sexual life.
Students know and explain addiction prevention methods.
Students become aware of traffic, disaster, and first aid.
Students know the importance of a healthy life and exercise.
